confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Japanese regional pricing, not checked against live menus or listings. Restaurant and café anchors are more reliable than accommodation, which varies with July tourism demand and Nara's limited hotel stock. Bar and wine prices are estimated from typical Japanese bar pricing rather than direct Nara data. USD figures assume a yen rate of roughly 150 per USD.
comparable_city_reasoning: Basis is regional Japanese tourist-city pricing, benchmarked to other mid-sized Japanese cities with heavy day-trip tourism. Restaurant and drink prices track typical Japanese regional levels. Accommodation is pitched somewhat below Kyoto for basic rooms, but with a summer peak premium for 3-star stock.
